shortDescription: This module manages objects/buckets in Google Cloud Storage.

options.name: dest
options.description: The destination file path when downloading an object/key with a GET operation.

options.name: expiration
options.description: Time limit (in seconds) for the URL generated and returned by GCA when performing a mode=put or mode=get_url operation. This url is only available when public-read is the acl for the object.

options.name: gs_access_key
options.description: GS access key. If not set then the value of the GS_ACCESS_KEY_ID environment variable is used.

options.name: gs_secret_key
options.description: GS secret key. If not set then the value of the GS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY environment variable is used.

options.name: mode
options.description: Switches the module behaviour between upload, download, get_url (return download url) , get_str (download object as string), create (bucket) and delete (bucket).

options.name: object
options.description: Keyname of the object inside the bucket. Can be also be used to create "virtual directories" (see examples).

options.name: overwrite
options.description: Forces an overwrite either locally on the filesystem or remotely with the object/key. Used with PUT and GET operations.

options.name: permission
options.description: This option let's the user set the canned permissions on the object/bucket that are created. The permissions that can be set are 'private', 'public-read', 'authenticated-read'.

options.name: region
options.description: The gs region to use. If not defined then the value 'US' will be used. See U(https://cloud.google.com/storage/docs/bucket-locations)

options.name: src
options.description: The source file path when performing a PUT operation.

options.name: versioning
options.description: Whether versioning is enabled or disabled (note that once versioning is enabled, it can only be suspended)
